findings.issue: Target says Set.ncard S = r.choose n. For r<n the right side is 0, and ncard = 0 also holds for an infinite set, so the target never asserts that S is empty although the answer says 'no solutions'. S is finite; the Lean statement just does not say so. Patched target adds Set.Finite S as a conjunct (compiled, same allowed axioms).

patch.target: ∀ n r : ℕ, {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | (∀ i, 1 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i = r + 1}.Finite ∧ {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | (∀ i, 1 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i = r + 1}.ncard = r.choose n
patch.proof:
by
  intro n r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (Set.finite_Iic (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => r + 1)).subset ?_
    intro x hx i
    have h1 : x i ≤ ∑ j, x j := Finset.single_le_sum (f := x) (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h2 : ∑ j, x j = r + 1 := hx.2
    show x i ≤ r + 1
    omega
  · show Set.ncard {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | (∀ i, 1 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i = r + 1} = r.choose n
    by_cases hr : r < n
    · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hr]
      have : {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | (∀ i, 1 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i = r + 1} = ∅ := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
        intro hx hs
        have : ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 1 ≤ ∑ i, x i := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hx i
        simp at this
        omega
      rw [this, Set.ncard_empty]
    · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, r = n + d := ⟨r - n, by omega⟩
      have hcount : Set.ncard {y : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | ∑ i, y i = d} = (n + d).choose n := by
        have h1 : Nat.card {P : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ // ∑ i, P i = d} = Nat.card (Sym (Fin (n + 1)) d) := Nat.card_congr (Sym.equivNatSumOfFintype (Fin (n + 1)) d).symm
        have h2 : Nat.card (Sym (Fin (n + 1)) d) = (n + d).choose d := by
          rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Sym.card_sym_eq_choose, Fintype.card_fin]
          congr 1
          omega
        rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
        change Nat.card {P : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ // ∑ i, P i = d} = _
        rw [h1, h2]
        exact (Nat.choose_symm_add).symm
      rw [← hcount]
      have hsum : ∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ, ∑ i, (y i + 1) = ∑ i, y i + (n + 1) := by
        intro y
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp
      have himg : {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | (∀ i, 1 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i = n + d + 1} = (fun y i => y i + 1) '' {y : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | ∑ i, y i = d} := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_image]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hx, hs⟩
          refine ⟨fun i => x i - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
          · have e : ∑ i, ((x i - 1) + 1) = n + d + 1 := by
              rw [← hs]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Nat.sub_add_cancel (hx i)
            rw [hsum] at e
            show ∑ i, (x i - 1) = d
            omega
          · funext i
            exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (hx i)
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨fun i => Nat.le_add_left 1 (y i), ?_⟩
          rw [hsum, hy]
          omega
      rw [himg]
      refine Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ ?_
      intro y y' h
      funext i
      have := congrFun h i
      simpa using this
patch.conclusion: 解の集合は有限で、その個数は$\binom{r}{n}$である（$r<n$のときは解が存在しない）。
patch.statement_en: For natural numbers n and r, the set of tuples of positive integers (x_0,...,x_n) with x_0+...+x_n=r+1 is finite and has C(r,n) elements (in particular it is empty when r<n).

findings.issue: n is allowed to be 0. 'The maximum of the outcomes is k' is meaningless for an empty tuple; the Lean filter (all<=k and exists =k) returns 0, and the formula gives 0 only through 0^0=1 at k=0 (and (k+1)^0-k^0=0 in general). True but accidental. Add 0<n (patched target and proof compile).

patch.target: ∀ (m n k : ℕ), 0 < n → k < m → ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => (∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) ≤ k) ∧ ∃ i, (ω i : ℕ) = k)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Fin n → Fin m) = (((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ n - (k : ℝ) ^ n) / (m : ℝ) ^ n
patch.proof:
by
  intro m n k _ hk
  have cnt : ∀ c : ℕ, c ≤ m → (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => ∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) < c)).card = c ^ n := by
    intro c hc
    have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => ∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) < c) = Fintype.piFinset (fun _ => Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin m => (x : ℕ) < c)) := by
      ext ω; simp
    have ec : (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin m => (x : ℕ) < c)).card = c := by
      rw [Fin.card_filter_val_lt]
      exact min_eq_right hc
    rw [e, Fintype.card_piFinset, Finset.prod_const, ec, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h1 := cnt (k + 1) hk
  have h2 := cnt k hk.le
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => ∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) < k + 1) = Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => (∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) ≤ k) ∧ ∃ i, (ω i : ℕ) = k) ∪ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => ∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) < k) := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union]
    constructor
    · intro hω
      by_cases he : ∃ i, (ω i : ℕ) = k
      · exact Or.inl ⟨fun i => Nat.le_of_lt_succ (hω i), he⟩
      · refine Or.inr fun i => ?_
        have := hω i
        have hne : (ω i : ℕ) ≠ k := fun h => he ⟨i, h⟩
        omega
    · rintro (⟨h, _⟩ | h) i
      · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (h i)
      · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (h i)
  have hd : Disjoint (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => (∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) ≤ k) ∧ ∃ i, (ω i : ℕ) = k)) (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => ∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) < k)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro ω hω hω'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hω hω'
    obtain ⟨_, i, hi⟩ := hω
    have := hω' i
    omega
  have hc := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd
  rw [← hs, h1, h2] at hc
  have hc' : ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ n = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Fin m => (∀ i, (ω i : ℕ) ≤ k) ∧ ∃ i, (ω i : ℕ) = k)).card : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) ^ n := by
    exact_mod_cast hc
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
  push_cast
  congr 1
  linarith
patch.openmath: (forall (m n k) (-> (and (in m N) (in n N) (> n 0) (in k N) (< k m)) (= (/ (size (suchthat (function_set (integer_range 1 n) (integer_range 0 (- m 1))) (lambda (w) (and (forall (i) (-> (in i (integer_range 1 n)) (<= (fn_value w i) k))) (exists (i) (and (in i (integer_range 1 n)) (= (fn_value w i) k))))))) (size (function_set (integer_range 1 n) (integer_range 0 (- m 1))))) (/ (- (^ (+ k 1) n) (^ k n)) (^ m n)))))

patch.statement_en: In n >= 1 independent trials, each uniform on {0, 1, ..., m-1}, for k < m the probability that the maximum of the outcomes equals k is ((k+1)^n - k^n)/m^n.

assumptions: ${}_{n}\mathrm{P}_{k}=n(n-1)\cdots(n-k+1)$（$k$個の積。$k=0$なら$1$、$k>n$なら積に$0$が現れて$0$）と定める
patch.answer: $n,k$を自然数とする。${}_{n}\mathrm{P}_{k}=n(n-1)\cdots(n-k+1)$とおく。これは$n$個から$k$個を選んで並べる順列の数に等しい（$1$番目から$k$番目までの選び方が$n,n-1,\dots,n-k+1$通りで、積の法則による）。$k>n$なら${}_{n}\mathrm{P}_{k}=0$、$\binom{n}{k}=0$で両辺は$0$である。$k\leq n$のとき、$n$個の異なるものから$k$個を選んで並べる順列を、並べるものの集合で分類する。$k$個の集合の選び方は$\binom{n}{k}$通りであり、選んだ$k$個の並べ方はそれぞれ$k!$通りである。積の法則より${}_{n}\mathrm{P}_{k}=\binom{n}{k}k!$である。

systemic: No Lean/text defect found in the 59 targets: every real division is guarded by Nonempty/nonzero-card hypotheses, every ℕ subtraction is guarded (k≤n, s≤k≤n, Nonempty S, T⊆S), choose/descFactorial vanish correctly for k>n, 0! cases are consistent, and elaborated coercions (checked with pp.coercions) are ℝ-division at the leaves. Probability is modelled as a raw ratio |E|/|Ω| (and E[X], P_A(B) as counting averages) on a Fintype, never as Mathlib uniformOn/PMF or a probability measure. Faithful for the school model, but every card inlines the ratio in OpenMath instead of reusing prob/cond_prob/expectation/uniform_measure_on from probability_statistics.yaml, so retrieval will not link school and measure-theoretic versions (bayes, total probability, independence-of-complement, linearity of E all exist there as separate cards).

Vocabulary fragmentation across files: binom (counting) vs binomial_coefficient (probability_statistics), indexed_union_over vs union_over, integer_range vs finset_range; several one-use symbols (strictly_increasing_fn, circular_arrangement_classes, dependent_pair_set, weak_compositions, pair_first/second) hide structure in the symbol.
Japanese statement/assumptions often omit the counting definitions of P_X(Y), E[X], E[X|A] that the Lean target uses (they appear only in statement_en and the answer).

Redundant algebraic variants: cond_prob_uniform_ratio/mul, falling_factorial_mul_factorial/…_choose together with combinatorics_graphs/binom_factorial_formula (any two imply the third), trinomial_coeff_product_binom vs multinomial_factorial_identity.

Constants are handled well: general parametric forms (n,k,r,m,s variables) throughout; remaining constants (2 groups in surjection_onto_two_count, 3 terms in trinomial_*) are named school patterns, kept; general surjection-count form is missing (see neighbors).
missing_neighbors: Monotonicity and Boole/union bound in the uniform model: A⊆B → P(A)≤P(B); P(⋃_{i∈I}A_i) ≤ Σ P(A_i); P(A∩B) ≤ min(P(A),P(B)) (Finset.card_le_card, Finset.card_biUnion_le).

Inclusion–exclusion for finitely many events in probability form, P(⋃A_i)=Σ_{∅≠T}(-1)^{|T|+1}P(⋂_{i∈T}A_i) (Finset.inclusion_exclusion_card_biUnion; only the count form exists in combinatorics_graphs), and the 3-set 'none of A,B,C' count.

Derangements (完全順列) in the school form: D_n = Σ_{k≤n}(-1)^k n!/k!, D_{n+2}=(n+1)(D_n+D_{n+1}), probability of no fixed point (card_derangements_eq_numDerangements, numDerangements_sum, card_derangements_fin_add_two); only the explicit formula exists in combinatorics_graphs.
General surjection count |Surj(A,B)| = Σ_{j=0}^{|B|}(-1)^j C(|B|,j)(|B|-j)^{|A|} (and 3-box case 3^n-3·2^n+3); no Mathlib lemma found by grep, needs inclusion–exclusion.

Unlabelled grouping (組分け): (2n)!/(2^n n!) perfect pairings, groups of equal size m·k: (mk)!/((k!)^m m!); and labelled groups of given sizes (multinomial, partly covered by words_given_letter_counts_multinomial).
Adjacency arrangements: k specified items adjacent → (n-k+1)!·k!; no two of k specified items adjacent → (n-k)!·C(n-k+1,k).
k-subsets of {1..n} with no two consecutive elements: C(n-k+1,k); also shortest lattice paths through a given point C(a+b,a)·C(c+d,c) and paths avoiding a point (subtraction).
Hypergeometric probability C(a,j)C(b,k-j)/C(a+b,k) and Σ_j of it = 1 (Vandermonde, in combinatorics_graphs), i.e. the probability form of hypergeometric_count.

Variance in the uniform model: V(X)=E[X²]-(E[X])², V(aX+b)=a²V(X), E(aX+b)=aE(X)+b, V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y) for X(ω1),Y(ω2) on a product space, binomial V=np(1-p) via counting (probability_statistics has measure versions binomial_variance_finite).

Conditional probability as a probability: P_A(B^c)=1-P_A(B), P_A(B∪C)=P_A(B)+P_A(C)-P_A(B∩C) for P(A)>0; chain rule for n events; mutual independence of three events (P(A∩B∩C)=P(A)P(B)P(C)) and pairwise-but-not-mutual counterexample.

Statistics 数学B 統計的な推測: sample mean E(X̄)=m, V(X̄)=σ²/n for independent identically distributed draws, standardisation E((X-m)/σ)=0, V=1; normal approximation to B(n,p) (Mathlib has ProbabilityTheory CLT / PMF.binomial, not school-level cards).

Binomial mode: P_k is maximal at k=⌊(n+1)p⌋ (corollary of binomial_prob_increase_iff) and Σ_k k·C(n,k)p^k(1-p)^{n-k}=np with real p (exists as probability_statistics/binomial_mean_finite; the school domain only has the uniform-model version expectation_trials_success_count).
